blocks.source: The zodiac represents one full circuit of the Sun. The spring equinox starts the year. Here, the Sun enters the bold sign of Aries. The year ends with the journey in Pisces, whose nature is to release. Each sign builds on the story.

blocks.target: El zodíaco representa un ciclo completo del Sol. El equinoccio de primavera da inicio al año. Aquí, el Sol entra en el audaz signo de Aries. El año termina con el recorrido por Piscis, cuya naturaleza es soltar. Cada signo construye sobre la historia.

blocks.source: The zodiac is the foundation of astrology. Divided into 12 zodiac signs that follow the seasonal year, it forms the bounding wheel of the birth chart.
